defaultDescription: Portfolio site for Andrew Hoffman featuring .NET, Xamarin Forms, and .NET MAUI work.

header.tagline: .NET Developer with a focus on Xamarin Forms/MAUI

about.intro: Hello! I'm Andrew. I enjoy building cross-platform mobile apps using .NET MAUI. I focus on making sure the final product matches the client expectations while also providing clients with best practices related to mobile development.

experience.description: I was responsible for a large front end and backend update on an existing Xamarin Forms app, as well as migrating that Xamarin Forms app to .NET MAUI. I was also responsible for updating and maintaining an existing .NET Core API that serviced the Forms and MAUI apps. I was also in charge of creating, updating, and maintaining build and release pipelines for the Apps and API in Azure Devops.

I created an app in Xamarin Forms that recorded screenshots on a users phone and then exported those screenshots into a Powerpoint slideshow. I also added new features to a Xamarin Forms app that allows users to complete inspections on equipment while out in the field. I also create a suite of apps in Xamarin Forms for warehouse workers to put and pick merchandise without requiring terminal access.

I was responsible for the creation of a Xamarin Forms app that allows users to complete inspections on equipment while out in the field, along with it's associated API. I also continued and finalized development on a Xamarin Forms app that displayed real time information from drilling wells.

I began development on a Xamarin Forms app that displayed real time information from drilling wells. I also created a SPA site that described a company led initiative. I also created a WPF desktop application for troubleshooting why something isn't working based on the 5 Whys Process.

contact.intro: I'm always open to discussing new projects, creative ideas, or opportunities to be part of your vision.
